items.headline: Trafigura closes upsized $4.4bn credit facility
items.summary: Trafigura closed a syndicated revolving credit and term loan package of roughly $4.4bn, upsized from $3.5bn after strong oversubscription from 40 banks, per the company's own announcement.

items.headline: Tanker rates soar, squeeze Asian crude buyers
items.summary: Reuters reports record tanker freight rates are pricing US crude out of reach for Asian refiners, pushing buyers toward Middle East and Latin American barrels instead.

items.headline: Tanker attacks spread beyond Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: At least a dozen tankers were attacked in late September and early October, with a chemical tanker hit near Qatar on October 7, cutting Gulf tanker traffic to a two-month low.

items.headline: Citi's Cogolludo joins Gen10 advisory board
items.summary: ETRM/CTRM vendor Gen10 added Citibank's Jose Cogolludo to its advisory board, per CTRM Center, a move likely aimed at deepening banking and risk-management expertise behind the platform.
